item.title: Rallying Cry – June 19, 2026
item.description: From a groundbreaking global reparations agreement in Ghana to a newly discovered Mozart manuscript set to premiere, plus a delightful apricot harissa chicken salad recipe and an adorable duck mascot joining Scotland’s Tartan Army, today’s good news is full of progress, creativity, and charm.
